title: What Can $11 Million Buy? — 34-vs-1 unit grid
description: Instagram square. A grid of 35 squares: 34 red (each = $1 opposing Platner) and 1 green ($1 supporting), an honest unit-chart encoding of the 34:1 spending ratio.
alt_text: Square graphic titled “What Can $11 Million Buy?” A grid of 35 squares: 34 red squares labeled “each square = $1 opposing (34)” and one green square labeled “= $1 supporting (1).” Footer lists $11,077,173 opposing versus $323,426 supporting.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
